LanguageData.RAF_ReformCaravanDesc: Leaving another player's map: only your own pawns will join the caravan. Sleeping enemies and enemies hidden by fog do not block departure.
LanguageData.RAF_SelectCaravanDesc: Your caravan "{0}" is on this tile. Select it, then right-click the world map to set a route.
LanguageData.RAF_ForeignCaravanSession: A player of faction "{0}" already has the caravan forming window open on this map. Ask them to press Cancel in that window and try again.
LanguageData.RAF_EnterMapSuffix: (the caravan will enter your friend's map)
LanguageData.RAF_SettlementAsksMap: Player settlement "{0}" is asking for: {1}.\nItems are taken from the inventory of your pawns on this map and from the ground, not from stockpiles. Available: {2} / {3}.
LanguageData.RAF_RequestNoLongerActive: The request is no longer active.
LanguageData.RAF_RewardDelivered: The trade request reward has been delivered next to your pawns.
LanguageData.RAF_NoPawnsOnMap: You have no pawns on this map.
LanguageData.RAF_MapFulfillDisabledMp: In multiplayer the request can only be handed in by a caravan from the settlement tile: do not enter the map, choose Visit instead, then use the Fulfill trade request button on the caravan. The reward goes into the caravan.
LanguageData.RAF_MapFulfillNoApi: The Multiplayer API is unavailable - the request can only be handed in by a caravan from the settlement tile.
